example.py: Jiē shàng yǒu yí ge qǐgài.
example.en: There is a beggar on the street.

example.zh: 我无意中听到了这件事。
example.py: wǒ wúyì zhōng tīngdào le zhè jiàn shì。
example.en: I heard about it by accident.

example.py: tā bǎ mǎ shuān zài shù shang。
example.en: He tied the horse to a tree.

example.zh: 报纸上有一则招聘启事。
example.py: Bàozhǐ shàng yǒu yì zé zhāopìn qǐshì.
example.en: There is a job notice in the newspaper.
example.ru: В газете есть объявление о приёме на работу.

example.py: Wǒ zài lù shang jiǎn dào yì zhī bǐ.
example.en: I picked up a pen on the road.

example.py: zhè cì wǒ lái fù qián。
example.en: This time I'll pay.

example.py: shīzhǔ gěi le tā yī bǐ chóujīn。
example.en: The owner gave him a reward.

example.py: qǐng dào chuāngkǒu lǐngqǔ bāoguǒ。
example.en: Please collect your parcel at the counter.

example.py: wǒ lùguò shūdiàn mǎi le běn shū。
example.en: I passed by the bookstore and bought a book.
example.ru: Проходя мимо книжного, я купил книгу.

example.py: zǒuláng li chuánlái jiǎobù shēng。
example.en: Footsteps sounded in the corridor.

example.py: zhège xiāoxi ràng wǒ hěn chījīng。
example.en: This news really shocked me.

example.py: tā zuìjìn yǒu hěn duō fánnǎo。
example.en: He has a lot of worries lately.

example.py: tiānqì yùbào shuō míngtiān xià yǔ。
example.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
example.ru: Прогноз погоды говорит, что завтра будет дождь.

example.py: jiérì li yóukè tèbié duō。
example.en: There are especially many tourists during holidays.

example.py: Wǒ bèi yǔ línshī le.
example.en: I got soaked by the rain.

example.zh: 大雨把他淋成了落汤鸡。
example.py: dàyǔ bǎ tā lín chéng le luòtāngjī。
example.en: The heavy rain soaked him like a drowned rat.
example.ru: Под ливнем он промок до нитки.

example.py: dōngxi dài duō le shì léizhuì。
example.en: Carrying too many things is a burden.

example.py: chénggōng zàiyú jiānchí。
example.en: Success lies in persistence.

example.py: zhèxiē guǎnggào zhēn fánrén。
example.en: These ads are really annoying.

example.py: tā kāi yī liàng jiù jiédá shàngbān。
example.en: He drives an old Jetta to work.
example.ru: Он ездит на работу на старой «Джетте».

example.py: huǒchē zài cǎoyuán shang bēnchí。
example.en: The train speeds across the grassland.

example.py: Wǒmen jiāohuàn le diànhuà hàomǎ.
example.en: We exchanged phone numbers.

example.py: rénshēng zhǐ yǒu yí cì。
example.en: You only get one life.

example.py: tā chéng le yǒumíng de fùwēng。
example.en: He became a famous rich man.

example.py: wǒ hěn xiànmù nǐ de gōngzuò。
example.en: I really envy your job.

example.py: bié fàngqì，zài shì yí cì。
example.en: Don't give up, try once more.

example.py: shuìmián ràng dànǎo dédào xiūxi。
example.en: Sleep lets the brain rest.

example.py: tā tíchū le yī ge hǎo jiànyì。
example.en: He put forward a good suggestion.

example.py: tā jiā hěn fùyǒu。
example.en: His family is very wealthy.

example.py: tā zuótiān zuò le shǒushù。
example.en: He had an operation yesterday.

example.py: zuò tí yào duō dòngnǎozi。
example.en: Use your brain more when solving problems.
example.ru: Решая задачи, нужно больше шевелить мозгами.

example.py: Háizimen guò de wúyōuwúlǜ.
example.en: The children live free of any worries.

example.py: bùzhībùjué tiān jiù hēi le。
example.en: Before we knew it, it was dark.
